'''Kenny Sidhu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 DecipherCon Team Event]] on 8 October 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT with exterior sites, 7s and tramples]], according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1322">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercond1322/ the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercon], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 11 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercond1322/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
